source.title: Nonlinear SPDEs and Maximal Regularity: An Extended Survey

outcomes.B18: Reformulated divergence-free variable transport as Lie transport plus a zero-order Hodge correction, exposing the moving Hodge/Stokes geometry hidden by the constant-translation special case; no theorem-level source progress claimed.
outcomes.B6: Froze smooth transport coefficients to the already solved constant point on parabolic tents. Coefficient oscillation becomes scale-small, but the needed Koch-Tataru T^{infinity,2}/Carleson endpoint estimate for the random moving Stokes/Hodge operator is not supplied by the finite-p stochastic tent-space theory found.
outcomes.B30: Isolated one nonconstant divergence-free periodic shear b(x)=sigma a(x_2)e_1 as the simplest source-valid special case. Its stochastic flow and pathwise elliptic shear metric are explicit, but endpoint control of the moving Hodge projection, convection and zero-order transport correction remains missing.

source_status: Problem 10 remains unresolved in a bounded literature check through 2026-09-17. Later stochastic-flow, deterministic VMO^{-1}, and stochastic tent-space results supply complementary pieces but no source-matching arbitrary-smooth-transport endpoint theorem or counterexample was found; negative search is not a novelty certificate.
history_gaps: Deployment text names predecessor handoff 2026-09-16T23-38-00Z__handoff.md, but the actual handoff body was recovered from creation commit 6ccbfad7a7fbcc7dbd839e38e00f2c6f3961afda and the immutable 23-47 report path.
simplest_unproved_special_case: T^3, g=0, a single smooth nonconstant divergence-free shear transport b(x)=sigma a(x_2)e_1 under the source parabolicity bound, at order -1 / smoothness <= -1/2.
next_obligation: For the single-shear model, formulate and prove or decisively obstruct a flow-adapted Koch-Tataru estimate for the time-dependent Stokes/Hodge evolution, using pressure/Hodge duality, volume-preserving invariants, and dyadic parabolic freezing. Do not repeat B18/B6/B30.
